program_control.start_rule: accepted for one cycle only when not busy; command_count must be 1 through 1024
program_control.terminal_status_rule: done or error stays asserted until reset or a later accepted start; faulted banks require reset before a later start

command_bram.record_assembly: two consecutive 128-bit words form one 256-bit instruction, lower word first

dma_executor.request: dma_cmd_valid/dma_cmd_ready with stable dma_cmd_data[255:0] while stalled

gemm_executor.request: gemm_cmd_valid/gemm_cmd_ready with stable gemm_cmd_data[255:0] while stalled

execution_contract.next_fetch_rule: never read the next instruction until the current executor response handshakes successfully
execution_contract.blocked_rule: hold current PC and decoded command; never inspect a later instruction
execution_contract.issue_rule: known opcode, legal operands, required source banks ready, destination bank free, and selected executor ready
execution_contract.reservation_rule: bank state changes for issue occur in the same cycle as request valid-and-ready
execution_contract.pc_rule: increment exactly once after a matching successful completion; final successful completion enters DONE without another fetch
execution_contract.tag_rule: completion tag must equal the current instruction tag
execution_contract.failure_rule: unknown opcode, illegal operand, response error, or tag mismatch enters ERROR and does not commit a destination ready
execution_contract.reset_rule: abort the active command state, clear terminal status and return every bank to free
execution_contract.program_image_rule: PS must keep instruction records and command_count stable from accepted start through done or error

bank_transitions.DMA_LOAD: dst free -> filling at issue -> ready on success or fault on failure
bank_transitions.DMA_STORE: src ready -> draining at issue -> ready on success, or free when release flag is set; failure returns src ready and enters ERROR
bank_transitions.GEMM: src0/src1 remain owned and dst free -> compute_active at issue -> ready on success or fault on failure; release flags may free sources only on success

required_cases: normal DMA_LOAD DMA_LOAD GEMM DMA_STORE completes strictly in order
blocked current command never fetches or issues the next command
request payload remains stable under executor backpressure
next BRAM address is not presented before current completion
unknown opcode and out-of-range bank reject
executor error prevents destination ready commit and stops later commands
reset during fetch issue and wait-completion returns all banks free
repeated program execution after successful completion

does_not_claim: AXI BRAM Controller or PS register wrapper
board integration, bitstream, or physical-board validation
